mapper.select: SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.PS, T1.REPO_TERM, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.SETTLE_SPEED, T1.TERM_TYPE, T1.DELIVERY_TYPE, T1.M_DELIVERY_TYPE, T1.CLEAR_TYPE, T1.EFF_TIME, T1.REMARK, T1.CCY, T1.PRIN_AMT, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.INT_AMT, NVL(T1.RATE,0) * 100 RATE, T1.TRADER, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.COUNTER_TRADER, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T3.ENTRUST_ID, T3.PORTFOLIO_ID, T3.REG_DATE_AMT, T6.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T4.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T2.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageId, T2.TRADE_AMT tradeAmount, T4.PLEDGE_RATIO, T4.PLEDGE_AMT FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE T2 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE T3 ON T2.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE_PRE T4 ON T2.TRADE_ID = T4.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T4.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T6 ON T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = T6.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,}

if.test: parentId == null or parentId == '' or parentId=='root'.toString()
parentId != null and parentId != '' and parentId != 'root'.toString()
status != null and status != '' and status == status_01

if.if: SELECT #{parentId} parentId /*树形表格父节点ID*/, '' childId /*树形表格子节点ID*/, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId /*交易编号*/, T2.BUSINESS_DATA businessData ,T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId /* add by songyawei */ FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN SYS_DATA_PROCESS_MARK T2 ON T1.WORKFLOW_ID = T2.WORKFLOW_ID WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

if.test: status != null and status != '' and status != status_01

if.if: SELECT #{parentId} parentId /*树形表格父节点ID*/, '' childId /*树形表格子节点ID*/, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId /*交易编号*/, T5.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T4.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, NVL(T3.PLEDGE_AMT,0)/10000 pledgeAmt, NVL(T3.PLEDGE_RATIO,0) * 100 pledgeRatio ,T5.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId /* add by songyawei */ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE_PRE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON (T3.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID OR T3.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID) AND T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T5.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

mapper.sql: SELECT 'root' parentId/*树形表格父节点ID*/, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID||'_'||#{status_01} childId /*树形表格子节点ID*/, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId /*交易编号*/, #{status_01} validStatus /*有效状态*/, TO_CHAR(T1.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDateText /*交易日期*/, T2.COUNTER_ID counter_id, /* add by songyawei */ T2.COUNTER_NAME counterId /*交易对手*/, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader /*对手方交易员*/, T1.PS ps /*交易方向*/, T1.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt /*交易金额*/, NVL(T1.RATE, 0) * 100 rate /*回购利率*/, T1.REPO_TERM repoTerm /*回购期限（天）*/, T1.SETTLE_SPEED settleSpeedText /*清算速度*/, T1.DELIVERY_TYPE deliveryType /*首期结算方式*/, T1.M_DELIVERY_TYPE mDeliveryType /*到期结算方式*/, T1.CLEAR_TYPE clearType /*清算类型*/, TO_CHAR(T1.EFF_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') effTime /*有效时间*/, T1.REMARK remark /*补充条款*/, T3.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId /*托管账号*/, T3.REGIST_ORG registOrg /*托管机构名称*/, T3.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName /*托管账户户名*/, T4.BUSI_ACCT_NO acctNo /*账户*/, T4.ACCT_NAME acctName /*户名*/, T4.BANK_DEP acctBankDep /*资金开户行*/, T4.LARGE_PAYNO acctBankDepoPayno /*资金开户行支付系统行号*/, 'CNY' bondCcy /*债券币种*/, 'CNY' settleCcy /*结算币种*/, T1.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, T1.WORKFLOW_STATUS workflowStatus ,T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId /* add by songyawei */ FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T2 ON T1.COUNTER_ID = T2.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO T3 ON T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T3.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T4 ON T3.TRD_ACCT_ID = T4.ACCT_NO AND T3.TRD_ACCT_CCY = T4.CCY WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F02},#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F03}) AND T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPE_TRD70} AND T1.IS_CANCEL != #{IS_CANCEL_Y} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE TPD, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE TPDA WHERE TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID AND TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID IN ( SELECT PPA.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY PPA WHERE PPA.USER_ID = #{loginUserName} ) )
